title: Compact maps into coproducts of shifts have finite thick support
statement: Let C be triangulated with coproducts [def-weil-triangulated-category], E:I→C any family (not necessarily compact), i:J→I and m:J→Z. For a compact object K [def-pc-compact-object] every map K→the coproduct of E_{i(j)}[m(j)] factors through an object of the thick envelope [def-pc-thick-closure] of the coproduct of E_i over some finite subset S of I.

proof.text: For compact K [def-pc-compact-object], the map to the coproduct A_j = E_{i(j)}[m(j)] is the image of x in the direct sum of Hom groups. Let S be the image under i of the finite support of x and let Q be the coproduct of A_j over this finite support. The sum of the components x_j into Q followed by its canonical inclusion is the given map, by DirectSum.sum_support_of. The shared finite_thick_mono theorem constructs the inclusion and zero-on-extra-summands retraction between two finite generator coproducts, and applies retract closure and triangEnvelope minimality. Both consumers import this theorem instead of duplicating the proof.

Every E_{i(j)} in the finite support is a retract of the unshifted sum over S, using its inclusion and projection. The thick envelope [def-pc-thick-closure] contains these generators and their shifts. It contains Q by finite-product closure and the isomorphism from the finite product to the finite coproduct. This also handles empty support.

lean.statement:
theorem compact_coproduct_finite_thick_support
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{w} C]
    {I J : Type w} (E : I → C) (i : J → I) (m : J → ℤ)
    (K : C) (hK : IsCompactObject K) (f : K ⟶ ∐ fun j : J ↦ (E (i j))⟦m j⟧) :
    ∃ (S : Finset I) (Q : C) (a : K ⟶ Q)
        (b : Q ⟶ ∐ fun j : J ↦ (E (i j))⟦m j⟧),
      (ObjectProperty.singleton (∐ fun i : {i : I // i ∈ S} ↦ E i.val)).triangEnvelope Q ∧
        a ≫ b = f
